items.title: What Is Drawing Fresh Attention To M&T Bank (MTB)?
items.summary: M&T Bank (MTB) has refreshed its M&T Visa Credit Card with Rewards, increasing points on grocery and gas spending while keeping flexible redemption options and no annual fee. This provides investors with another lens on its consumer focus. The share price of M&T Bank closed at US$224.43 on 2 November 2026, with recent momentum softening as the 90 day share price return declined 11.31%. This follows a 9.99% year to date gain and a 26.34% 1 year total shareholder return. Multi year total...

items.title: UMBF Q3 Earnings Beat on Higher NII, El Dorado Buyout Deal Announced
